newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Air System to launch commuter airline--paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan Air System to launch commuter airline--paper.

text.p: Japan Air System Co Ltd plans to launch an airline company before the end of 1997 to operate commuter flights between regional airports, a Japanese business daily said.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported over the weekend that the new airline would be jointly set up with the prefectural government of Hokkaido. The airline is expected to open four routes between cities in the northern island before the end of March 1998.
The paper said that the new airline will be the first of six regional commuter airlines that Japan Air System plans to set up in Japan.
A spokesman for the company was not immediately available to comment on the report.
